name: Pre-movement time
what: From the cue to leaving the flat: noticing, interpreting, deciding, and anything done before the door. The whole of TTS.
notes: Every egress model has this, under some name. Our value is read off a published fit at a quantile the persona decides.

name: Walking speed on the level
what: Free walking speed in an empty corridor. The model slows it for crowding and smoke itself.

name: Patience behind a blockage
what: Seconds in a stalled queue before giving up on a route and trying another.
notes: Some models have no equivalent and simply never reroute.

name: Visibility at which they turn back
what: Visibility below which this resident turns back rather than pressing on. Zero means never.

name: Tries another route after turning back
what: On turning back, tries a different staircase rather than returning home.

name: Can use stairs
what: Whether stairs are available to this resident at all. The one output with no distribution: it is a fact about the person, not a draw.

name: Gathering time
what: Seconds spent collecting a pet, a child or documents. Reported separately because some models fold it into pre-movement and some give it its own state.
notes: Double-counting risk: if a model's pre-movement fit already includes pre-evacuation actions, adding this on top counts them twice. See the note on effect E001.

name: Chance of taking the wrong route
what: Chance of choosing a worse route than the one available, from not knowing the building.

name: Habitual route
what: The staircase this resident reaches for by habit. Proulx found residents chose familiar stairs over nearer ones.
notes: No engine we know of reads this yet; it is here because the finding is solid and the output is the shape it would take.

name: Neighbours they would warn
what: How many people outside the flat this resident would knock for or call on the way out.
notes: An input to warning propagation, which no engine we have models.
